title: node/run
description: Run one operation. in gives every value it takes: a literal, or {{node.path}} / {{in.path}} / {{const.name}} / {{resolver}} to read one. Runs the moment every value it reads has settled and every node it names under after has answered.

type.description: Marks this node a run: it calls one operation.

description.description: What this node does, for a reader of the graph.

label.description: A short human name for this node, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its id.

after.description: Nodes of this graph this node waits for without reading their answers: it starts only once each has answered, as if it read them, and its operation is not given them. A node behind a switch's branch makes this node run only on that branch; one that refuses or breaks means this node never starts. Names a node that is not this one, not a switch, and not one this node already reads (G029, G030).
